quests.instruction: Which meal do people eat in the morning, after a long night without food?
quests.hint: Ask yourself what you want when you wake up hungry.
quests.explanation: Breakfast is the first meal of the day. Its name comes from breaking the fast of the night.
quests.funFact: Breakfast foods differ around the world, from congee in China to oatmeal in the United Kingdom.

quests.instruction: What food is usually eaten for breakfast rather than dinner?
quests.hint: It comes in a box and is poured into a bowl.
quests.explanation: Cereal is quick and easy, so it is a popular morning food. Curry and pizza are more often eaten later in the day.
quests.funFact: The first breakfast cereals were invented in the 1800s.

quests.instruction: What do we call a small amount of food eaten between meals?
quests.hint: It keeps you going until the next meal.
quests.explanation: A snack is a small bite between meals. A feast is a very large meal, and dessert is the sweet part at the end of a meal.
quests.funFact: The word snack comes from an old Dutch word meaning to bite.

quests.instruction: Which meal do many children eat at school around the middle of the day?
quests.hint: Many people pack a box for it.
quests.explanation: Lunch is the midday meal. Breakfast comes in the morning and a snack is a small bite between meals.
quests.funFact: In some countries, such as Spain and Mexico, lunch is the biggest meal of the day.

quests.instruction: At a restaurant, a small dish arrives before the big dish. What is it called?
quests.hint: It is small so that it does not fill you up yet.
quests.explanation: A starter is a small first dish. Dessert comes last and a snack is eaten between meals.
quests.funFact: Starters are also called appetizers, because they are meant to wake up your appetite.

quests.instruction: Which part of a meal is usually the biggest, most filling dish?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which dish is the star of the meal.
quests.explanation: The main course is the largest part of the meal. A starter is small and dessert is a sweet finish.
quests.funFact: In many cultures, the main course includes a staple food such as rice, bread or potatoes.

quests.instruction: Which meal do many families share together in the evening?
quests.hint: It comes after the school or work day is over.
quests.explanation: Dinner is the evening meal. Lunch is eaten in the middle of the day and dessert is a sweet treat at the end of a meal.
quests.funFact: Dinner can simply mean the main meal of the day, which is not always eaten in the evening.

quests.instruction: A family wants a warm meal for a cold evening. Which choice fits best?
quests.hint: Think about what warms you up from the inside.
quests.explanation: Soup is served hot, so it warms you up on a chilly night. Ice cream and fruit salad are cold.
quests.funFact: Hot meals feel comforting in cold weather because they warm us up.

quests.instruction: It is a very hot afternoon. Which snack would be the most refreshing?
quests.hint: It is cool and full of water.
quests.explanation: Watermelon is juicy and cool, so it refreshes you on a hot day. Hot soup and roasted chestnuts are served warm.
quests.funFact: Cool, juicy foods are popular in hot places because they are so refreshing.

quests.instruction: Which drink is the best everyday choice for quenching thirst, with no added sugar?
quests.hint: It comes straight from the tap.
quests.explanation: Plain water quenches thirst without added sugar. Soda and fruit punch usually contain extra sugar.
quests.funFact: Water is the main ingredient in most of the drinks we have.

quests.instruction: Which warm drink is made from milk and cocoa?
quests.hint: It is a favorite on a chilly day.
quests.explanation: Hot chocolate is made by mixing cocoa with warm milk. Lemonade is cold and made from lemons, and a smoothie is blended fruit.
quests.funFact: Hot chocolate began as a bitter drink made by ancient peoples of Central America.

quests.instruction: What drink is the clear liquid found inside young coconuts?
quests.hint: You can sip it straight from the coconut with a straw.
quests.explanation: Coconut water is the thin liquid inside a young coconut. Apple juice comes from apples and soy milk comes from soybeans.
quests.funFact: Coconut water is lightly sweet and is popular in tropical places.

quests.instruction: A child wants a quick snack to carry outside before playing. Which one is easy to carry and gives natural energy?
quests.hint: It comes in its own wrapper.
quests.explanation: A banana is easy to carry and has natural sugars for energy. Stew and ice cream are hard to carry.
quests.funFact: Bananas come in their own natural wrapper, so they are easy to carry anywhere.

quests.instruction: Which snack has protein, which helps you feel full for longer?
quests.hint: It is cooked in its shell and then peeled.
quests.explanation: Eggs are a protein food, so they help you feel full. Gummy bears and lollipops are made mostly of sugar.
quests.funFact: A cooked egg can be peeled and packed as a ready-to-eat snack.

quests.instruction: On a long hike with no fridge, which snack travels best in a backpack?
quests.hint: It does not need to stay cold.
quests.explanation: Raisins are dried, so they keep well without cooling. Yogurt and ice cream would spoil or melt.
quests.funFact: Dried fruit weighs less than fresh fruit because the water has been removed, which makes it easier to carry.

quests.instruction: Which lunchbox has foods from the most different food groups?
options: Plain bread and a plain bread roll 🍞
A cookie and a small bag of chips 🍪
quests.hint: Count how many kinds of food are in each lunchbox.
quests.explanation: This lunch has grain, dairy, fruit and vegetables. The others have only a couple of kinds of food.
quests.funFact: Many school lunches around the world combine a grain, a protein food and vegetables or fruit.

quests.instruction: Which lunchbox food needs an ice pack to stay cool?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which food could spoil if it gets warm.
quests.explanation: Yogurt is made from milk, so it spoils if it is left warm. Apples and crackers keep well without cooling.
quests.funFact: Foods that spoil easily are kept cold, at about five degrees Celsius or below.

quests.instruction: Last night's cooked rice was kept in the fridge. Which lunch could it turn into?
quests.hint: It is rice pressed into a shape.
quests.explanation: Cooked rice can be shaped into rice balls for lunch the next day. Pancakes and pretzels are not made from rice.
quests.funFact: Leftover cooked rice should be cooled quickly and put in the fridge soon after cooking.

quests.instruction: Tortilla chips are often served with a dip made from chopped tomatoes, onions and chili. What is the dip?
quests.hint: It can be mild or spicy.
quests.explanation: Salsa is a fresh sauce made of chopped vegetables. Butter and honey are not used as dips for chips.
quests.funFact: Salsa is the Spanish word for sauce.

quests.instruction: Which topping would add natural sweetness to a bowl of oatmeal?
quests.hint: It is small, juicy and sweet.
quests.explanation: Berries are naturally sweet, so they add flavor to oatmeal. Pickles and olives are sour or salty.
quests.funFact: Berries are sweet enough to flavor food without adding any sugar.

quests.instruction: What fruit is often served beside cheese on a snack plate?
quests.hint: It comes in a bunch that is easy to pick from.
quests.explanation: Grapes are sweet and easy to eat, so they pair well with salty cheese. Lemons are too sour and pineapples are harder to serve.
quests.funFact: Cheese plates often mix sweet fruit with salty cheese because the tastes balance each other.

quests.instruction: Which food is often shared at a birthday celebration, with candles on top?
quests.hint: It is a sweet treat for a special day.
quests.explanation: Cake is a celebration food in many countries. Soup and salad are everyday dishes.
quests.funFact: Birthday cakes with candles are a tradition in many countries, and people often make a wish.

quests.instruction: A classmate has a milk allergy. Which snack is safe to share with them?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which foods are made from milk.
quests.explanation: Cheese and yogurt are made from milk, so a person with a milk allergy must avoid them. Apple slices are not dairy.
quests.funFact: Food labels list common allergens such as milk, eggs and nuts to help people stay safe.

quests.instruction: A friend does not eat meat. Which dish could you serve them for dinner?
quests.hint: Look for the dish that is made from plants.
quests.explanation: Vegetable curry has no meat. Some people do not eat meat for health, belief or personal reasons, and plant dishes work well for them.
quests.funFact: Many vegetarian dishes come from long traditions, such as lentil dal in India.

quests.instruction: In a meal of rice, chicken and broccoli, which food is the staple, the filling base of the meal?
quests.hint: It takes up the most space on the plate.
quests.explanation: A staple is the main filling food in a meal, and here that is the rice. Chicken is the protein and broccoli is the vegetable.
quests.funFact: Staple foods like rice, wheat, corn and potatoes are the base of meals in many parts of the world.

quests.instruction: Steak is the main dish on a dinner plate. Which food would be served beside it as a side dish?
quests.hint: It is a savory food that goes with meat.
quests.explanation: A side dish is a smaller dish served next to the main dish. Cake and ice pops are desserts.
quests.funFact: Side dishes often add color and variety to a plate.

quests.instruction: Which item is mostly added to give flavor to a meal, not to fill you up?
quests.hint: A squeeze of it makes food taste fresh.
quests.explanation: A lemon wedge adds a splash of sour flavor. Bread and rice are filling foods.
quests.funFact: A squeeze of lemon can make fish and vegetables taste fresher.

quests.instruction: Which dinner plate has a vegetable, a grain and a protein food?
quests.hint: Look for one food from each of those three kinds.
quests.explanation: Fish is a protein food, rice is a grain and peas are a vegetable. The other plates are missing at least one of them.
quests.funFact: Fish and rice meals are common in many coastal countries.

quests.instruction: After a soccer game on a hot afternoon, which pair would refresh you best?
quests.hint: Think about cool, juicy and watery.
quests.explanation: Water and juicy orange slices replace liquid and are refreshing. Hot soup is too warm, and pizza with cake is heavy.
quests.funFact: You lose water when you sweat, so you need a drink after being active.

quests.instruction: Which list shows the main meals in the order people usually eat them through the day?
quests.hint: The day begins with the first meal after waking up.
quests.explanation: Most people eat breakfast in the morning, lunch in the middle of the day and dinner in the evening.
quests.funFact: Many cultures add small meals, such as snacks or tea time, between the main ones.
